points.why: It describes the archetype in substance as a rich-get-richer, path-dependent process where early success compounds, without using the archetype's name.
It says the rule feeds back on itself and that paper counts partly measure the allocation earlier counts caused, not quality.
It recommends changing the rule, with a minimum allocation per group, per-capita or quality-weighted allocation, or multi-year smoothing.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly rejects past output as proof of merit and asks for per-capita and quality measures.
It never frames the dynamic as the groups reacting to each other or as Escalation.
